tools.name: notion-search
tools.description: Search Notion with short, specific keywords. Returns matching pages and databases with their ids and URLs.

tools.name: notion-fetch
tools.description: Retrieves a Notion page, database or data source by URL or ID. Databases return their data sources in <data-source url="collection://..."> tags; fetch the collection:// URL for its schema and use it with notion-query-data-sources or as the parent of new pages.

id.description: The ID or URL of the page, database, or data source (collection://...)

tools.name: notion-create-database
tools.description: Creates a new Notion database from a SQL DDL CREATE TABLE statement. Without a parent, it is created as a private page at the workspace level. Returns the database id and its data source in a <data-source> tag.

title.description: The title of the new database

description.description: The description of the new database

schema.description: SQL DDL, e.g. CREATE TABLE ("Name" TITLE, "Tags" MULTI_SELECT('a':blue), "Done" CHECKBOX, "When" DATE, "Count" NUMBER, "Link" URL, "Notes" RICH_TEXT, "Kind" SELECT('x':gray))

tools.name: notion-create-pages
tools.description: Creates one or more Notion pages with properties and Notion Markdown content. For a database, fetch it first and use its collection:// data source as parent. Checkbox values are "__YES__"/"__NO__"; dates split into "date:<Name>:start" and "date:<Name>:is_datetime".

tools.name: notion-update-page
tools.description: Update a Notion page's properties or content. Commands: update_properties (with properties), replace_content (with new_str replacing the whole page), update_content, insert_content.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to update

new_str.description: For replace_content: the new content of the whole page

tools.name: notion-query-data-sources
tools.description: Query Notion data sources. SQL mode: {"data": {"data_source_urls": ["collection://..."], "query": "SELECT * FROM \"collection://...\""}}. Rows mode: {"data": {"mode": "rows", "data_source_url": "collection://..."}}. Fetch the data source first for its schema.

tools.name: notion-move-pages
tools.description: Move one or more Notion pages or databases to a new parent.

tools.name: notion-delete-pages
tools.description: Move Notion pages to Trash. Use only when the user explicitly asks to delete specific pages. Without user_confirmed: true, nothing is trashed.
